raw.rationale: Bendamustine is a bifunctional alkylating agent with broad DNA-damaging activity and no established lineage-specific dependency, so in a 5-day PRISM screen it is expected to show only modest, non-selective cytotoxicity; published PRISM data indicate few if any lineages meet the selective-killing threshold. Probabilities are therefore near the low base rate, with slight elevation for lymphoid-derived or DNA-repair-deficient lineages, though none of the listed lineages are lymphoid.
